exposure: Location of endometriosis (left or right side of incisions)
outcome: Clinical characteristics and surgical results of scar endometriosis
cohort: 24 patients who underwent surgery and were diagnosed with scar endometriosis
finding: In the event of a mass in the abdominal wall, previous obstetric and gynecologic operations and a history of a painful mass during menstruation periods must be questioned.
mod_finding: History of cesarean section was present in 9 patients, twice in 12, and 3 times in three patients.
